sql: SELECT firstName, lastName, deathYear - birthYear FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND deathYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.lgID IN ('PCHA','NHL') GROUP BY T1.playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.lgID)=2
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL)/COUNT(T2.playerID) FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY COUNT(T2.playerID) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID JOIN Teams T3 ON T2.tmID=T3.tmID WHERE T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T1.birthCountry='Canada' AND T1.pos='G'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameGiven, T3.name, T2.year FROM Master T1 JOIN Coaches T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID JOIN Teams T3 ON T2.tmID=T3.tmID AND T2.year=T3.year WHERE T1.playerID IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.nameGiven, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL)/SUM(T2.GP) FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID='aebisda01' AND T1.pos='G' GROUP BY T1.nameGiven
SELECT COUNT(tmID) FROM Goalies WHERE year=2005 AND ENG IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.coachID) FROM Coaches T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID WHERE T1.w>30 AND T2.birthCountry='USA'
SELECT T1.firstName FROM Master T1 JOIN HOF T2 ON T1.hofID=T2.hofID WHERE T1.shootCatch IS NULL
